answer: The tide index is deterministic from ledger replay, and hence nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 801 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the ripple. Flooding registration pushes an copycat to the back of the vault queue while honest participants promoted earlier still earns. Each impostor pays 2 dollars up front. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
